referenceFidelity.findings: Blue ground and varied coral/cream/blue flowing lines follow the vocabulary of the portfolio’s Tyler Hobbs office mural photographs. These paths are independently authored; no tracing or source painting is embedded.

construction.findings: Thirty-five coherent stroke outlines have fitted ends and remain attached to the backing. Crossing paths are intentional graphic overlaps; flat rear is closed and front layers have explicit depth separation.

readability.findings: Line rhythm and contrasting dark background read at phone width; sparse gold nodes and the bottom branch glyph provide accents without dominating the pattern.

motion.findings: Static wall-mounted graphic panel, no rig or clips requested.

secondPass.findings: Finished GLB compared again with the six reference photographs after centre-tentacle correction on character panels. Front and close-up retain consistent face/ear landmarks; oblique has no detached graphic edges; rear is intentionally plain and closed; phone captures were reframed after viewport reduction. No additional scoped construction repair remains.

userAcceptance.note: Author review completed; user artistic acceptance is not inferred.

limitations: Original simplified graphic interpretations, not replicas of commissioned paintings.
